subject: Wavefront SIG evidence aggregation & delivery plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavefront.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Wavefront Procurement <procurement@wavefront.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Wavefront SIG questionnaire & evidence rollup request

Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. As we discussed, Wavefront is running an expedited SIG questionnaire for our security review. We need a control-level evidence rollup covering the SIG/Shared Assessments baseline plus SOC 2 and ISO 27001 artifacts where applicable.

Top asks from procurement & security:
- A single index (spreadsheet) that maps each SIG control to the corresponding Redwood artifact and a short description.
- Delivery of redacted SOC 2 report (if available) and ISO 27001 cert or bridge letters.
- Samples of access logs, change control tickets, and one or two runbooks for incident response/backup.
- A single secure download location (S3/Drive) and a proposed timeline.

Can your team provide the index and initial artifacts by 2027-05-06? If any items are considered privileged (legal/for-embargo), flag them so we can handle an NDA/secure transfer.

Thanks — looking forward to the plan.

Sanjay Rao
Head of Vendor Security
Wavefront Analytics
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavefront.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wavefront SIG questionnaire & evidence rollup request

Sanjay —

Appreciate the clear list. We can meet the 2027-05-06 date for the index and an initial artifact packet. Proposed approach:

1) Evidence index: we’ll use the attached template (evidence_index_template.xlsx) and populate control -> artifact -> short description -> access type (public/redacted/privileged).
2) Delivery location: we will provision a time-limited S3 bucket and share a pre-signed folder. If you prefer Google Drive, we can mirror.
3) Artifact plan: redacted SOC 2 report, ISO 27001 certificate/summary, sample access logs, change control exports, incident runbook excerpts, KMS & key rotation policy. For privileged items we’ll request an NDA and send via our secure transfer.
4) Owners: Marcus will lead technical artifacts (logs, runbooks), Mina will coordinate compliance docs (SOC/ISO), Karthik will be copied for vendor/intake coordination.

Action items I’ll take now:
- Populate and return the index template by 2027-04-28 with a first-pass of available artifacts.
- Create S3 staging and share link + permissions guidance.
- Flag any items that require legal/NDA prior to delivery.

If this works, I’ll kick off the internal collection today.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_index_template.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wavefront SIG questionnaire & evidence rollup request

Priya —

Quick status from engineering/compliance perspective: we can supply the following artifact set for the initial packet by 2027-05-03:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (summary + control exceptions redaction).
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement (PDF).
- Access log samples (cloud front + inference runtime) — anonymized, limited to last 90 days (see attached sample).
- Change control export (tickets + SR references) for the last 6 months.
- Incident response runbook excerpts and one postmortem (redacted).
- KMS key rotation policy and proof-of-rotation artifact for sample keys.

Note on privileged items: full raw logs and unredacted SOC 2 artifacts are flagged by Legal as privileged. If Wavefront needs those, Legal will require an executed NDA and a secure transfer process (SFTP or signed agreement for limited viewing).

I will prepare a set of control narratives for the 10 most commonly-requested SIG controls (identity & access, change management, encryption, continuity, monitoring, vendor management, etc.). Those narratives will be attached to the index. Expect the narratives by 2027-04-30.

Attachments planned for staging: redwood_control_narratives_v1.docx; access_log_samples_2026-10.csv

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@wavefront.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Wavefront Procurement <procurement@wavefront.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wavefront SIG questionnaire & evidence rollup request

Priya / Marcus —

Thank you for the fast turnaround and the clear plan. Wavefront confirms the 2027-05-06 hard deadline for the full index + initial artifacts. We are fine with an S3 pre-signed folder (please mark files that require NDA).

Two items from procurement:
1) We need a mutually-executed NDA to access privileged artifacts. I’ve opened a DocuSign envelope for a standard vendor confidentiality agreement: https://docusign.com/secure/EnvelopeID/XXXX-1234 (procurement ref: WF-P0-8819).
2) Please include a single cover memo in the staging folder that lists each file, redaction level, and point of contact. That helps our intake team accelerate validation.

If you can share the index template populated by 2027-04-28 that will allow us to confirm gaps quickly. Appreciate the cooperation — Wavefront is moving quickly on this procurement.

Best regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Vendor Security
Wavefront Analytics
